title: The Dog and the Cook
summary: A house dog invited a stray dog to attend his master's grand banquet. The stray entered the kitchen, admiring the roasts and anticipating a feast....
full_text:
A house dog invited a stray dog to attend his master's grand banquet. The stray entered the kitchen, admiring the roasts and anticipating a feast.

The master cook, seeing a strange cur wagging his tail in the pantry, seized the dog by the hind legs and hurled him through the open window into the cobblestone courtyard.

Limping home bruised and starving, the stray told his companions: "The feast was so magnificent that I drank so much wine I cannot even remember how I left the house!"
moral: Never attend an entertainment upon an invitation from one who owns neither house nor dinner.
